title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 28 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Chronicles chapter 28 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 28 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Chronicles Chapter 28.

questions.question: Who did David assemble at Jerusalem according to 1 Chronicles 28:1?
options: Princes of Israel, captains, stewards, officers, mighty men, and valiant men
The women and children of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Princes of Israel, captains, stewards, officers, mighty men, and valiant men
questions.explanation: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, captains over thousands and hundreds, stewards over possessions, officers, mighty men, and valiant men unto Jerusalem as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:1.

questions.question: What was David's initial intention regarding the ark of the covenant as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:2?
options: To build a house of rest for it
To offer it as a sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: To build a house of rest for it
questions.explanation: David said he had in his heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and for the footstool of God, according to 1 Chronicles 28:2.

questions.question: Why did God forbid David from building a house for His name in 1 Chronicles 28:3?
options: Because David was a man of war and had shed blood
Because the temple was already built
Because David was not a king
questions.correctAnswer: Because David was a man of war and had shed blood
questions.explanation: God told David he could not build a house for His name because David had been a man of war and had shed blood, as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:3.

questions.question: Which tribe did the LORD choose to be the ruler of Israel according to 1 Chronicles 28:4?
questions.correctAnswer: Judah
questions.explanation: The LORD chose Judah to be the ruler, and David from the house of Judah was made king over all Israel, as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:4.

questions.question: Who did God choose among David's sons to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel in 1 Chronicles 28:5?
questions.correctAnswer: Solomon
questions.explanation: God chose Solomon, David’s son, to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel, according to 1 Chronicles 28:5.

questions.question: What was Solomon's role according to the LORD's message to David in 1 Chronicles 28:6?
options: To build the house and courts of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: To build the house and courts of the LORD
questions.explanation: God told David that Solomon would build His house and courts, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 28:6.

questions.question: What condition did God set for establishing Solomon's kingdom forever in 1 Chronicles 28:7?
options: If Solomon is constant to do God's commandments and judgments
questions.correctAnswer: If Solomon is constant to do God's commandments and judgments
questions.explanation: God promised to establish Solomon's kingdom forever if he remains constant in obeying God's commandments and judgments, according to 1 Chronicles 28:7.

questions.question: True or False: David told Solomon to serve God with a perfect heart and a willing mind in 1 Chronicles 28:9.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: David instructed Solomon to serve God with a perfect heart and willing mind in 1 Chronicles 28:9.

questions.question: True or False: David was allowed by God to build the house for His name because he was a man of peace, according to 1 Chronicles 28:3.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: God forbade David from building the house because he was a man of war and had shed blood, as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:3.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Chronicles 28:7, God's establishment of Solomon's kingdom depends on Solomon's obedience to God's commandments.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:7 states that Solomon's kingdom will be established forever if he continues to obey God's commandments and judgments.

questions.question: True or False: David said God chose him to be king over Israel because he was the strongest warrior in his family, according to 1 Chronicles 28:4.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: David said God chose him before all the house of his father to be king, not because of strength but God's choice, as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:4.

questions.question: In 1 Chronicles 28, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: Keep and seek all the commandments of the LORD
Be strong and build the house
Know the God of your father
questions.correctAnswer: David assembling princes of Israel
questions.explanation: David first assembled all the princes and leaders before giving other instructions, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 28:1.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 28:1, which group was NOT mentioned as being assembled by David?
options: Stewards over all the substance of the king
questions.correctAnswer: Foreign ambassadors
questions.explanation: Foreign ambassadors were not mentioned; David assembled princes, captains, stewards, officers, mighty men, and valiant men as per 1 Chronicles 28:1.

questions.question: Who did David say God would be to Solomon if Solomon built the house for the sanctuary, according to 1 Chronicles 28:6?
questions.correctAnswer: A father
questions.explanation: God said to David that He would be a father to Solomon if he builds the house, as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:6.

questions.question: What did David say to Solomon to encourage him to build the house in 1 Chronicles 28:10?
options: Ask for help from other nations
Wait until the time is right
questions.correctAnswer: Be strong and do it
questions.explanation: David encouraged Solomon to be strong and to build the sanctuary as instructed in 1 Chronicles 28:10.

medium.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 28 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Chronicles Chapter 28 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 28, what condition must Solomon meet for his kingdom to be established forever?
options: If he remains constant to do God's commandments and judgments
If he builds the house exactly as David instructed
If he conquers all neighboring nations
If he sacrifices daily at the altar
questions.correctAnswer: If he remains constant to do God's commandments and judgments
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:7 states the kingdom will be established forever if Solomon is constant to do God's commandments and judgments, emphasizing obedience over building or conquest.

questions.question: What does David instruct Solomon to do with the house for the sanctuary, according to 1 Chronicles 28?
options: Wait for divine signs before starting
questions.correctAnswer: Be strong and do it
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:10 shows that David commands Solomon to be strong and to do the work of building the house, stressing courage and action.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 28:9 teach about how Solomon should serve God?
options: With a perfect heart and a willing mind
questions.correctAnswer: With a perfect heart and a willing mind
questions.explanation: Verse 9 instructs Solomon to serve God with sincerity and willingness, showing the importance of inner devotion rather than external formality.

questions.question: What will happen if Solomon seeks God, according to 1 Chronicles 28:9?
options: He will be found by God
He will be tested by God
questions.correctAnswer: He will be found by God
questions.explanation: The verse assures that God searches all hearts and will be found if sought sincerely, highlighting the promise of God's accessibility to those who seek Him.

questions.question: What warning does David give Solomon about forsaking God in 1 Chronicles 28?
options: God will cast him off forever
questions.correctAnswer: God will cast him off forever
questions.explanation: David warns that if Solomon forsakes God, God will cast him off forever, emphasizing the seriousness of faithfulness (verse 9).

questions.question: Why did God not allow David to build the house for His name, according to 1 Chronicles 28?
options: Because David was a man of war and had shed blood
Because the people demanded Solomon to build
questions.correctAnswer: Because David was a man of war and had shed blood
questions.explanation: Verse 3 explains that God forbade David from building the house due to his history as a warrior who shed blood, thus choosing Solomon instead.

questions.question: What did David give Solomon concerning the house of the LORD, as described in 1 Chronicles 28?
options: The pattern of the porch, houses, treasuries, and the place of the mercy seat
The laborers to build the house
A large sum of money to build
questions.correctAnswer: The pattern of the porch, houses, treasuries, and the place of the mercy seat
questions.explanation: Verses 11 and 12 indicate David gave Solomon detailed plans and patterns for the temple’s structure and sacred places.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 28 highlight the role of the priests and Levites in the service of the house of the LORD?
options: They are assigned courses and work for the temple service
They are to lead the military defense
They are to build the temple walls
questions.correctAnswer: They are assigned courses and work for the temple service
questions.explanation: Verse 13 specifies the courses of priests and Levites for temple service, indicating organized worship and duties.

questions.question: What does David provide by weight for the temple services in 1 Chronicles 28?
options: Gold and silver for instruments of service
Wood and stone for the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Gold and silver for instruments of service
questions.explanation: Verses 14-18 describe David giving weighted amounts of gold and silver for various temple instruments and vessels used in worship.

questions.question: What encouragement does David give Solomon about fear and courage for the temple work in 1 Chronicles 28?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 20 encourages Solomon to be strong and courageous, telling him not to fear or be dismayed because God will be with him.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 28, will David's God fail or forsake Solomon until the temple work is finished?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 20 clearly states that God will not fail or forsake Solomon until he finishes the temple work.

questions.question: Are the princes and all the people wholly at Solomon's command for the temple service according to 1 Chronicles 28?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 21 affirms that princes and all the people will be wholly at Solomon’s command to support the temple service.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 28:8 promise will happen if the people keep and seek all the commandments of the LORD?
options: They will possess the good land and leave it as inheritance forever
They will become wealthy beyond measure
They will defeat all their enemies immediately
questions.correctAnswer: They will possess the good land and leave it as inheritance forever
questions.explanation: Verse 8 promises possession of the good land and lasting inheritance if God's commandments are kept, emphasizing obedience leading to blessing.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 28:11–12 describe the source of the plans for the temple?
options: David received them by the spirit and gave them to Solomon
They were copied from older temples
They were given through a prophet other than David
questions.correctAnswer: David received them by the spirit and gave them to Solomon
questions.explanation: Verses 11 and 12 show David was given the temple pattern by the spirit and passed these details to Solomon for construction.

questions.question: What practical lesson about leadership and faithfulness can be drawn from David's charge to Solomon in 1 Chronicles 28:20-21?
options: Leaders should be courageous, rely on God's presence, and have willing skilled helpers
Leaders must act alone and control all aspects personally
Leadership is only about military strength
Faithfulness is secondary to political alliances
questions.correctAnswer: Leaders should be courageous, rely on God's presence, and have willing skilled helpers
questions.explanation: Verses 20-21 teach that strong leadership involves courage, trust in God, and relying on skilled, willing helpers for success in God’s work.

hard.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 28 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Chronicles Chapter 28.

questions.question: What materials did David give by weight for the candlesticks and their lamps according to 1 Chronicles 28?
questions.correctAnswer: Gold and silver
questions.explanation: David gave gold by weight for the candlesticks and their lamps, and silver by weight for the candlesticks and lamps thereof, as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:15.

questions.question: Which items did David also provide gold and silver for, besides the candlesticks and lamps?
questions.correctAnswer: Tables of shewbread
questions.explanation: David gave gold for the tables of shewbread and silver for the tables of silver as per 1 Chronicles 28:16.

questions.question: What does the gold given for the fleshhooks, bowls, and cups signify about temple worship?
options: The importance of purity and sanctity in offerings
The wealth of the king only
The use of these items in battle
questions.correctAnswer: The importance of purity and sanctity in offerings
questions.explanation: The gold and silver for fleshhooks, bowls, and cups highlight the sacred nature and purity required for temple service, as described in 1 Chronicles 28:17.

questions.question: What was refined gold used for in the temple according to David's instructions?
questions.correctAnswer: The altar of incense
questions.explanation: David specified refined gold by weight for the altar of incense, emphasizing its sacredness (1 Chronicles 28:18).

questions.question: What covered the ark of the covenant as described in 1 Chronicles 28?
questions.correctAnswer: The wings of cherubims
questions.explanation: David described the pattern of the chariot of cherubims that spread out their wings and covered the ark of the covenant (1 Chronicles 28:18).

questions.question: How did David say that the LORD made him understand all the works of the temple pattern?
options: In writing by his hand upon David
By a dream during the night
questions.correctAnswer: In writing by his hand upon David
questions.explanation: David stated that the LORD made him understand in writing by his hand upon him all the works of the pattern (1 Chronicles 28:19).

questions.question: What encouragement did David give to Solomon regarding the building of the house of the LORD?
options: Be strong and of good courage; fear not nor be dismayed
Wait until you are older to start
Build only when the people agree
questions.correctAnswer: Be strong and of good courage; fear not nor be dismayed
questions.explanation: David encouraged Solomon to be strong and courageous, not to fear or be dismayed, because God would be with him until the work was finished (1 Chronicles 28:20).

questions.question: Who did David say would be with Solomon to assist in the service of the house of God?
options: Priests, Levites, willing skillful men, princes, and all the people
questions.correctAnswer: Priests, Levites, willing skillful men, princes, and all the people
questions.explanation: David assured Solomon that priests, Levites, every willing skillful man, princes, and all the people would be under his command for the temple service (1 Chronicles 28:21).

questions.question: The Hebrew word for 'pattern' used in this chapter most closely means:
options: A blueprint or model for imitation
questions.correctAnswer: A blueprint or model for imitation
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term for 'pattern' (תֶּבְנִית, tevnit) refers to a blueprint or model to be followed precisely, as used in 1 Chronicles 28:11-19 for the temple design.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage also gives a detailed divine pattern for sacred construction similar to 1 Chronicles 28?
questions.correctAnswer: Exodus 25:9
questions.explanation: Exodus 25:9 records God instructing Moses to make the tabernacle according to the pattern shown on the mountain, paralleling the divine pattern theme in 1 Chronicles 28:19.

questions.question: David's charge to Solomon to 'know the God of thy father and serve him with a perfect heart' is echoed in which New Testament book emphasizing wholehearted devotion?
questions.correctAnswer: Acts 17
questions.explanation: Acts 17:23-27 emphasizes knowing and serving God with the heart, reflecting Solomon's charge in 1 Chronicles 28:9.

questions.question: What literary device is predominantly used in David’s speech to Solomon encouraging him to be 'strong and of good courage'?
questions.correctAnswer: Repetition for emphasis
questions.explanation: David uses repetition of encouragement phrases ('Be strong and of good courage; fear not, nor be dismayed') in 1 Chronicles 28:20 to emphasize courage and faithfulness.

questions.question: True or False: David was allowed by God to build the temple because he was a man of war who had shed blood.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: God told David he could not build the temple because he was a man of war and had shed blood, as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:3.

questions.question: True or False: Solomon was chosen by God to build the house of the LORD and establish his kingdom if he obeyed God's commandments.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: David affirmed that Solomon was chosen to build the house and that his kingdom would be established forever if he remained obedient, as found in 1 Chronicles 28:6-7.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 28, what was the purpose of assembling all the princes, captains, and mighty men in Jerusalem?
options: To receive David's instructions about building the temple
To prepare for war against the Philistines
To celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles
questions.correctAnswer: To receive David's instructions about building the temple
questions.explanation: David assembled all these leaders to instruct them concerning the building of the house of the LORD, as described in 1 Chronicles 28:1-2.

theological.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 28 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Chronicles Chapter 28 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What reason did God give David for not allowing him to build the house for His name?
options: David had shed blood as a man of war
questions.correctAnswer: David had shed blood as a man of war
questions.explanation: God told David he could not build the house because he had been a man of war and had shed blood, as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:3.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 28:5, who did the LORD choose among David's sons to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel?
questions.correctAnswer: Solomon
questions.explanation: Verse 5 clearly states that the LORD chose Solomon, David's son, to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 28:9 emphasize about God's knowledge and how Solomon should serve Him?
options: God searches all hearts and understands all imaginations of thoughts
God is unaware of secret plans
questions.correctAnswer: God searches all hearts and understands all imaginations of thoughts
questions.explanation: Verse 9 teaches that the LORD searches all hearts and understands the imaginations of thoughts, urging Solomon to serve with a perfect heart and willing mind.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is most clearly demonstrated in David's reassurance to Solomon that God will not fail or forsake him until the work is finished?
questions.correctAnswer: Faithfulness
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:20 reveals the attribute of God's faithfulness as David assures Solomon that God will not fail nor forsake him until the work is finished.

questions.question: What theological doctrine is illustrated by God's promise to establish Solomon's kingdom forever conditional on his obedience to commandments and judgments?
questions.correctAnswer: Conditional covenant
questions.explanation: Verse 7 teaches that Solomon's kingdom will be established forever if he remains constant to God's commandments, showing a conditional covenant based on obedience.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 28:1 describe the assembly David called together, and what does this reveal about leadership and service in Israel?
options: Only priests and Levites were called
All princes, captains, stewards, officers, and valiant men were assembled
questions.correctAnswer: All princes, captains, stewards, officers, and valiant men were assembled
questions.explanation: Verse 1 lists a broad assembly of leaders and servants, indicating a comprehensive and organized leadership structure under the king for God's purposes.

questions.question: What does the pattern and detailed instructions given by David to Solomon for building the house indicate about the nature of divine worship according to 1 Chronicles 28:11-12?
options: Worship requires precise, divinely revealed order and design
Worship can be improvised by leaders
The temple design was a human invention
questions.correctAnswer: Worship requires precise, divinely revealed order and design
questions.explanation: Verses 11-12 show that David gave Solomon a pattern inspired by the Spirit, emphasizing that the house of the LORD must be built according to God's specific design for proper worship.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the detailed plans for the temple in 1 Chronicles 28 demonstrate human invention rather than divine inspiration. What does 1 Chronicles 28:19 actually teach about the origin of these plans?
options: The plans were created by Solomon's architects
David understood the plans through his own wisdom
The LORD made David understand the plans in writing by His hand upon him
The plans were a later addition by temple priests
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD made David understand the plans in writing by His hand upon him
questions.explanation: Verse 19 explicitly states that the LORD made David understand the pattern in writing by His hand, affirming divine inspiration rather than human invention.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal truth is taught by 1 Chronicles 28:6 and 1 Chronicles 28:10 regarding Solomon's role and God's relationship to him?
options: Solomon is chosen to build the house and God promises to be his Father, empowering him to be strong in the task
Solomon is rejected but must build the house anyway
Solomon is only a political king with no divine relationship
God will build the house without Solomon's involvement
questions.correctAnswer: Solomon is chosen to build the house and God promises to be his Father, empowering him to be strong in the task
questions.explanation: Verse 6 shows God choosing Solomon and promising to be his Father, while verse 10 commands Solomon to be strong and do the task, linking divine sonship with empowerment for service.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 28:8 reveal the communal responsibility of Israel in maintaining the covenant for possession of the land?
options: Every individual must keep and seek the commandments to possess the land and leave an inheritance
The land is possessed automatically without obedience
questions.correctAnswer: Every individual must keep and seek the commandments to possess the land and leave an inheritance
questions.explanation: Verse 8 commands the entire congregation of Israel to keep and seek God's commandments in order to possess the land and secure it for their descendants, emphasizing corporate covenant responsibility.

questions.question: What narrative arc does 1 Chronicles 28:4 contribute to regarding God's sovereign choice within the tribal and familial line of Israel?
options: God randomly appointed leaders without pattern
God chose Judah and David specifically from his father's house to be king over all Israel forever
God rejected Judah in favor of Ephraim
Leadership was determined by popular vote
questions.correctAnswer: God chose Judah and David specifically from his father's house to be king over all Israel forever
questions.explanation: Verse 4 shows God's sovereign choice of David from the tribe of Judah and his father's house, highlighting the divine election that fits into the Messianic lineage narrative.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 28:21 teach about the collaboration between priests, Levites, craftsmen, princes, and the people in the service of the house of God?
options: Only the king has authority over the temple service
The priests and Levites alone work without others
All groups, including skilled craftsmen, princes, and the people, will be at Solomon's command to serve the house of God
The temple service is optional for the people
questions.correctAnswer: All groups, including skilled craftsmen, princes, and the people, will be at Solomon's command to serve the house of God
questions.explanation: Verse 21 describes a unified cooperation among various groups under Solomon's leadership for the temple's service, emphasizing the communal nature of worship and sacred work.

questions.question: Which theological doctrine is illustrated by the LORD's promise to be a father to Solomon as stated in 1 Chronicles 28:6?
questions.correctAnswer: Adoption into God's family
questions.explanation: Verse 6 emphasizes God’s fatherly relationship to Solomon, foreshadowing the doctrine of adoption where believers are brought into God's family.

questions.question: What does the extensive giving of gold and silver for temple instruments and vessels in 1 Chronicles 28:14-18 reveal about the holiness of worship and the use of material resources?
options: Worship should be done with the cheapest materials
Material resources should be dedicated richly and precisely to honor God’s sanctuary
Gold and silver are irrelevant to worship
The temple was a place for personal treasure
questions.correctAnswer: Material resources should be dedicated richly and precisely to honor God’s sanctuary
questions.explanation: Verses 14-18 show that precious metals were given by weight for temple service, teaching that worship requires costly and dedicated offerings reflecting God's holiness.

questions.question: What combined teaching do 1 Chronicles 28:9 and 1 Chronicles 28:20 provide about the spiritual qualities necessary for leadership in God's work?
options: Leadership requires a perfect heart, willing mind, strength, courage, and trust in God's presence and faithfulness
Leadership is a matter of political skill alone
God abandons leaders after commissioning them
questions.correctAnswer: Leadership requires a perfect heart, willing mind, strength, courage, and trust in God's presence and faithfulness
questions.explanation: Verse 9 calls Solomon to know God with a perfect heart and willing mind; verse 20 encourages strength, courage, and reliance on God’s faithfulness, together outlining spiritual leadership qualities.
